notes: Assumes the Eastern Route is the east-peak ascent from the Goat Mountain trail. identifiedBy.fact: Skyline II trail from Silver-Skagit Rd to camp at Monument 74 Peak north of Hozomeen, the camp base for north-side routes

otherFacts.value: day one long hike to a bivouac; day two 4.5 h to the launch point via loose 3rd-class gully and rock ribs
Skyline II to Monument 74 camp ~10.5 mi, ~4000 ft gain to Hozameen Ridge

notes: Medium confidence. Sources: route's own stored text (Silver-Skagit Rd, Skyline II near km 55 serving camp north of the peak) plus onehikeaweek Skyline II report (camp north of peak). AAJ Zorro Face article (bivouac, downclimb gully from north-ridge notch) and colinhaley.com (best access from Canadian side) are consistent but name no trailhead. Hozomeen border crossing is closed, so the US campground is not a usable start.
